context: Two managers prepare a formal proposal mentioning their company
purpose: Teach: 自社/弊社/実務/早期/起動/表記/務め/パート

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 明日の提案書ですが、弊社の強みを冒頭でしっかり打ち出したいですね。
lines.en: About tomorrow's proposal, I'd like to emphasize our company's strengths at the very beginning.
lines.style: Formal business tone, polite and measured opening from a senior manager.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 賛成です。自社開発の体制を具体的に書けば、説得力が増すと思います。
lines.en: I agree. If we describe our in-house development structure concretely, it should be more convincing.
lines.style: Professional female manager, calm and constructive, building on her colleague's point.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: そうですね。それから、実務経験豊富なメンバーが揃っていることも強調しましょう。
lines.en: Right. And let's also emphasize that we have members with extensive practical experience.
lines.style: Polite agreement followed by a concrete additional suggestion, business register.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: では、早期に試作品をお見せできる点もアピールしてはいかがでしょうか。
lines.en: Then, how about also highlighting that we can show a prototype at an early stage?
lines.style: Polite proposal phrased as a question, smooth keigo from a thoughtful manager.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: いいですね。あと、表記のゆれは最終チェックで必ず直しておいてください。
lines.en: Good idea. Also, please be sure to fix any inconsistent wording during the final check.
lines.style: Approving then giving a clear, polite instruction about document quality control.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 承知しました。社名のローマ字表記も統一しておきます。
lines.en: Understood. I'll also unify the romanized notation of the company name.
lines.style: Crisp business acknowledgment, immediately committing to a concrete follow-up action.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 助かります。私はプレゼン用のノートPCを早めに起動して動作確認しておきますね。
lines.en: That's a big help. I'll boot up the presentation laptop early and check it works.
lines.style: Warm thanks followed by his own task, collaborative senior-manager voice.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。資料の最終チェックは私が務めますので、ご安心ください。
lines.en: Thank you. I'll take charge of the final document check, so please rest assured.
lines.style: Gracious keigo, taking responsibility firmly but politely to reassure her colleague.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 頼もしいです。明日は冒頭のパートを私が説明しますので、よろしくお願いします。
lines.en: Very reassuring. Tomorrow I'll explain the opening part, so I appreciate your support.
lines.style: Appreciative business close, dividing responsibilities and confirming the next-day plan.
